design: Slender adult female archivist, small rounded cranial crest, delicate angular four mandibles, side-looped silver dreadlocks. Ivory asymmetrical sleeveless robe, dark sage diagonal sash, deep triangular robe split showing bare clawed feet and ankle wraps. Left arm cradles three narrow flat archive plates in a cloth sleeve, right hand holds a small checksum disc. Pale olive skin, attentive rightward gaze.
